_note: Source of truth for the author block. The skill writes this `author` object into site.json `metadata.author` (and sets the top-level `author` string to the name) so the resume-theme sidebar renders the presenter — resume-theme reads name, image, email, phone, location, website, website2, socialLink, socialLink2 from metadata.author. The LinkedIn and X posts do NOT include a personal handle/signature after the hashtags. The YouTube SEO description Links section uses linkedin, github, and website. No twitter or mastodon fields are used; socialLink carries LinkedIn and socialLink2 carries GitHub.
